header.title: Password reset email is sent twice
header.status_inferred: in qa, not yet in release

stage.text: Merged to qa (PR #812, 2026-10-16) · not yet in release/2026.10

claims.text: The retry job resends the email when the first send times out, because the sent flag is written only after the mail call returns.
Timeouts happen only above 5 s, which QA hits under load.
A duplicate scheduler (one instance on QA).
claims.label: ruled-out

steps.text: On success it sets sent = 1; a timeout leaves it 0, so the next run sends again.

sections.heading: How it works after the fix

steps.text: The job marks the row sending.
It sets sent = 1, or clears sending on failure.

claims.text: Mark the row before the call, so a retry skips a send in progress.

rejected.text: A unique key on the message id (the mail service has none).

list.text: Not yet in release/2026.10: both commits

summary.text: The job now records a send before making it.

claims.text: A crash can leave rows in sending; they need a sweep.
claims.label: recorded

claims.text: A second worker would skip rows marked sending.
claims.label: suggested
